newsitem.title: USA: Marathon cuts US posted crudes $1.25/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Marathon cuts US posted crudes $1.25/bbl.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co, citing the expiry of NYMEX January crude Thursday, said it cut the price it will pay for U.S. crude oil by $1.25 a barrel, effective today.
The decrease brings the new price for U.S. benchmark grade West Texas Intermediate to $23.50 a barrel, and West Texas Sour to $22.15 a barrel.
Light Louisiana sweet crude is now $24.00 a barrel, and Oklahoma sweet is $23.50.
Marathon is part of USX-Marathon Group.
